title: E1: Independent Human Functional Strength Validation

protocol.hypothesis: Directly measured antagonist EMG reduces active joint torque prediction RMSE relative to simple sEMG across unseen human participants.

models.M0: Fold training mean torque: tau_pred = mean(tau_train)
models.M1: Linear sEMG: tau_pred = beta_0 + beta_1 * sEMG_agonist
models.M2: M4 Model: tau_pred = beta_0 + beta_1 * sEMG_agonist + beta_2 * angle + beta_3 * velocity
models.M3: Bridge Proxy: tau_pred = f_active(sEMG_VL, theta, dtheta) - gamma_proxy(sEMG_VL)
models.M4: Bridge Measured Antagonist: tau_pred = f_active(sEMG_agonist, theta, dtheta) - f_antagonist(sEMG_antagonist, theta, dtheta)

protocol.primary_endpoint: Paired RMSE reduction in MVC fractions relative to M1: Delta_RMSE = RMSE(M1) - RMSE(M4)

decision_thresholds.GO: Mean Delta_RMSE >= 0.02 MVC with 95% bootstrap CI strictly > 0 and sustained in > 50% of participants
decision_thresholds.NO_GO: Mean Delta_RMSE < 0.02 MVC or 95% CI crossing zero
decision_thresholds.DATA_BLOCKED: Absence of fully qualified independent human cohort meeting all pre-registration data criteria

calibration_regimes.Regime_B: Pre-defined MVC normalization (subject gain anchored to isometric MVC)

Bird_2026_Dryad.reason: Bird 2026 was the development cohort for EXP-0045/46. Furthermore, it only instrumented Vastus Lateralis (0 antagonist channels). Proxying gamma from VL yielded NEG-0044 (-0.1148 R^2 vs -0.0528 for sEMG).

Wang_2022_Zenodo.reason: Wang 2022 records whole-body locomotion (walking/running/squats). Joint moments are derived from inverse dynamics via OpenSim ground reaction forces, not directly measured on a dynamometer load cell. Lacks isolated dynamic knee extension series and MVC normalization.

Sanchez_Sotelo_2014_UCI.reason: Contains leg extension with RF, VM, BF, ST and knee goniometer, but completely lacks any torque transducer or dynamometer. Predicting torque without ground truth torque is physically impossible.

rationale: No qualified independent human cohort exists in public repositories that simultaneously provides synchronized dynamometer active knee torque, joint angle, angular velocity, raw agonist EMG, raw antagonist EMG, and participant MVC calibration. Per SUBJECT-01 integrity rules, synthetic antagonist signals and circular reuse of development data (Bird 2026) are strictly prohibited. Experiment E1 is DATA_BLOCKED.

historical_benchmark_exp0046.finding: Coactivation model with VL-derived proxy was inferior to simple sEMG by 0.062 R^2 units (NEG-0044).

unblocking_specifications.required_instrumentation: Biodex isokinetic dynamometer + multi-channel Delsys EMG
unblocking_specifications.protocol_required: Isokinetic knee extension at 60 deg/s and 120 deg/s, passive baseline, MVC ramps
